summary: End-to-end ML platforms handle the full lifecycle of custom models: data preparation, training, fine-tuning, experiment tracking, model registry, deployment, and monitoring at scale. You need one when you're training or fine-tuning your own models, managing many experiments and model versions, or deploying inference at enterprise scale with governance; if you only consume pretrained models via an API (e.g., OpenAI, Anthropic, Bedrock), you typically don't need a full platform until you add custom training, RAG infrastructure, or production MLOps. In 2026 the market splits between cloud-native suites (SageMaker, Vertex AI, Azure ML), the lakehouse-led Databricks, automated/enterprise platforms (DataRobot, H2O.ai), and best-of-breed MLOps tooling (MLflow, Weights & Biases, Kubeflow, Modal).

platforms.name: Amazon SageMaker
platforms.pricing: Pay-as-you-go by compute/storage usage (instance-hours, endpoints, storage); no upfront fees, with savings plans available
platforms.best_for: AWS-native engineering teams wanting deeply integrated infrastructure, security, and the broadest cloud customer footprint

platforms.name: Databricks (MLflow + Mosaic AI)
platforms.pricing: Consumption-based DBUs (Databricks Units) plus underlying cloud compute; tiered by workload
platforms.best_for: Data-team-led purchases needing shared governance, lakehouse data, and multi-cloud flexibility

platforms.name: Google Vertex AI
platforms.pricing: Pay-as-you-go by training/prediction node-hours, storage, and Gemini API usage
platforms.best_for: GCP-centric teams wanting tight integration with BigQuery, TPUs, and Google's foundation models

platforms.name: Azure Machine Learning
platforms.pricing: Pay-as-you-go by compute (VM/instance-hours) and storage; no surcharge over underlying Azure compute
platforms.best_for: Microsoft/Azure enterprises needing governance, compliance, and integration with Azure OpenAI and the Microsoft stack

platforms.name: MLflow
platforms.pricing: Free and open source; managed versions billed via Databricks or hosting provider
platforms.best_for: Teams wanting a standard, open, framework-agnostic experiment tracking and model registry layer

platforms.name: Weights & Biases
platforms.pricing: Free tier for individuals; usage/seat-based subscriptions for teams and enterprise
platforms.best_for: ML research and deep-learning teams needing best-in-class experiment tracking and collaboration

platforms.name: Kubeflow
platforms.pricing: Free and open source; you pay only for underlying Kubernetes infrastructure
platforms.best_for: Platform teams wanting full control and portability of MLOps on Kubernetes without vendor lock-in

platforms.name: DataRobot
platforms.best_for: Enterprises and analyst-led teams wanting automated model building with strong governance and low-code workflows

platforms.name: H2O.ai
platforms.pricing: Open-source core free; enterprise subscription for Driverless AI and managed cloud
platforms.best_for: Teams wanting open-source AutoML plus enterprise generative AI and strong interpretability

platforms.name: Modal
platforms.pricing: Usage-based per-second billing for CPU/GPU compute; pay only for active runtime
platforms.best_for: Startups and developers wanting fast, Python-native serverless GPU training and deployment without managing infra

platforms.name: Metaflow
platforms.pricing: Free and open source; managed via Outerbounds subscription
platforms.best_for: Data science teams wanting a human-friendly Python framework for production ML pipelines
